chunks: 1764 - And he, peace be upon him, said:
“A dirham by which the Imam is supported is better than a thousand thousand dirhams spent on other than him in the way of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.”

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: better; greater in merit and virtue
key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the Imam; the divinely appointed leader
key_terms.دِرْهَمٌ: a dirham; a small unit of wealth or money
key_terms.عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic; an honorific for Allah
key_terms.فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ: in the way of Allah; for God's cause
key_terms.يُوصَلُ: is conveyed or delivered; given in support

ai.seo_question: Why is supporting the Imam with wealth considered greater than spending large amounts in the way of Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the immense merit of financially supporting the Imam. It teaches that even a small amount directed toward the Imam carries greater virtue than a vastly larger sum spent elsewhere, highlighting the centrality of the Imam's right and authority.
